purpose: Registry of deliberate conflicts planted in the knowledge base, and of topics deliberately absent from it. Every contradiction between documents must appear here. A contradiction that is not registered is a defect in the corpus, not an experimental condition.
gold_data_warning: THIS FILE IS EVALUATION GOLD DATA. It contains expected answers, prohibited assertions and the list of unanswerable topics. No component of the inference pipeline may read it. It is addressed under config.evaluation, never under config.paths, and tests assert that no pipeline module imports it. Reading it at inference time would be oracle leakage and would invalidate every result.
notes: Superseded documents are indexed rather than filtered out at ingestion time. Filtering would remove the conflict before the model saw it, and detecting conflicts is the capability under evaluation.

Families of type version_supersession can in principle be resolved by a metadata filter on status alone, without any claim-level reasoning. They are therefore not sufficient on their own to demonstrate that verification adds value. Families of type current_current exist for that reason: both documents are live, both are authoritative, and no metadata field distinguishes them. A filter cannot resolve them.

The evaluation should compare three arms: naive retrieval over all documents, retrieval filtered to current documents only, and the full verification pipeline. The second arm is the obvious cheap alternative to this project's contribution and must be beaten on the current_current families to justify it.

The share of superseded documents is deliberately higher than would be typical for a real SME so that conflict handling can be measured rather than illustrated. This is a threat to external validity and is stated as such in docs/CORPUS.md.
Multiple paraphrased questions drawn from one family are not independent observations. Results must be macro-averaged by family, not micro-averaged by question.

resolved_supersession.rationale: Once the system has identified which document supersedes which and answered from the current one, the answer is correct and well grounded. Capping it at medium would understate a resolution the system genuinely achieved, and would make the confidence signal uninformative.

unresolved_conflict.answer_with: both positions, neither asserted as authoritative
unresolved_conflict.next_action: escalate to the named document owners for reconciliation
unresolved_conflict.rationale: Two live documents disagree and nothing in the corpus establishes precedence. Choosing one silently is the failure mode this project exists to prevent.

unanswerable.rationale: Refusing is correct. Estimating from adjacent material is the hallucination this project measures.

families.name: Backup retention against the data retention schedule

conflicting_facts.fact: how long data survives once its retention period has expired

values.IT-04: an annual backup of all business systems is kept for seven years
values.REG-02: records are deleted at the end of their retention period, including from backups at the next rollover

anchors.IT-04: An annual backup is retained for seven years
anchors.REG-02: deleted, including from backups at the next backup cycle rollover

must_not_assert: that data is fully deleted at the end of its retention period
that a seven-year backup is compatible with a 31-day CCTV retention period
families.why_a_filter_cannot_solve_this: Both documents are current and neither is a version of the other. The conflict is between an operational practice and a compliance requirement, which is precisely the kind of contradiction that survives in real organisations because each document is correct within its own department's frame.
families.risk_note: CCTV is scheduled for deletion after 31 days, yet an annual backup would preserve it for seven years. That is a live UK GDPR storage limitation exposure.
families.no_satisfying_action_because: A record whose retention period is shorter than seven years cannot both be deleted from backups at the next rollover and be held in a seven-year annual backup. Keeping and deleting are the action.

families.name: Approval authority for IT equipment purchases (negative control)

conflicting_facts.fact: who approves an IT equipment purchase of £800

values.GEN-04: the department head, and additionally the Finance Manager because the cost exceeds £750
values.FIN-03: the department head, under the £501 to £2,500 band

anchors.GEN-04: written approval from the department head and, where the cost exceeds £750, from the Finance Manager

must_not_assert: that the two documents contradict each other
that only one of the two approvers is required
families.why_a_filter_cannot_solve_this: Both documents are current and neither supersedes the other. The general procurement policy and the IT-specific policy overlap without either stating precedence.
families.origin: Found during review as an accidental contradiction and registered rather than harmonised. Real organisations acquire exactly these overlaps when a specific policy is written without reconciling it against the general one.
families.reconciliation: GEN-04 requires approval 'from the department head AND, where the cost exceeds £750, from the Finance Manager'. That is cumulative, not alternative. FIN-03 places £501 to £2,500 with the department head. Obtaining both approvals satisfies both documents; GEN-04 is simply stricter for IT equipment. There is no contradiction.
families.note: Registered as a conflict until 8 August 2026. The registry recorded GEN-04's position as 'the Finance Manager, because the cost exceeds £750', dropping the 'department head and' that makes the requirement cumulative, which turned a stricter rule into a competing one. The anchor check passed because the shortened phrase is a literal substring: a substring can be truthful and still mislead once the conjunction in front of it is cut away. Reclassified as a negative control under amendment 1.2. A verifier that flags this is producing a false positive.

reconciliation_anchors.GEN-04: written approval from the department head and, where the cost exceeds £750, from the Finance Manager

The type was asserted at planting time and nothing forced it to be justified, so four families were typed by intuition and typed wrongly. Every family now states the fact that decides its type and a test enforces it. CONF-11 was mutually_exclusive. values.OPS-05: mandatory for everyone at all times, including visitors passing through

families.note: Reclassified 13 August 2026 under amendment 1.5. It was mutually_exclusive, justified by the claim that at 35 days overdue OPS-01 has not yet held orders. That inference denies the antecedent: OPS-01's 45-day rule is a sufficient condition for holding, not a licence to trade below it. The justification field records that a reason was given, not that the reason is sound, and this is the case that shows the difference.

deliberate_gaps.purpose: Topics absent from the corpus by design, used to generate unanswerable questions. A correct system refuses; an incorrect one invents policy. Probes are stored here rather than in code so that adding a gap does not require a code change.

fully_absent.topic: maternity, paternity and shared parental leave
company car and vehicle allowance schemes

fully_absent.note: Whether the company ships internationally IS answerable from CS-11, which states it does not ship outside the United Kingdom. Only the export documentation procedure is absent. Questions must target the procedure, not the availability, or they are not unanswerable.

partially_present.gap: HR-04 states that new employees work on site for the duration of their probationary period, but no document defines how long that period is or what happens at the end of it.
partially_present.expected_behaviour: state what is known, state explicitly that the duration is not covered, do not estimate

partially_present.gap: HR-05 names the ACAS Code of Practice on disciplinary and grievance procedures, so the word appears in the corpus, but no grievance procedure is documented. Retrieval will surface HR-05 with reasonable similarity and HR-05 cannot answer the question.
partially_present.expected_behaviour: refuse, and say that only the disciplinary procedure is documented; do not describe HR-05 as if it were a grievance procedure
